sentences.text: It is classified as a basal titanosaurian, sharing several primitive characteristics with slightly younger relatives like Epachthosaurus and Andesaurus.
The genus was first described and named by Jean Le Loeuff, Suravech Suteethorn, and Eric Buffetaut in 2013.
The type species, Normanniasaurus genceyi, honors Pierre Gencey, who discovered the remains in July 1990.

The holotype specimens, which include a partial skeleton with presacral vertebrae fragments, a partial sacrum, anterior and middle caudal vertebrae, a right scapula, ilia and ischia fragments, and parts of the femur and fibula, are housed at the Museum d'histoire naturelle du Havre.
However, other estimates place its time range within the Albian stage, from 110.1 to 106.3 million years ago.
